title: Apply and resubmit for A-List
description: Read a reviewer request, update the structured artist submission and send it back for review.

steps.caption: 1. Open A-List Submission. Your status and the reviewer's message appear above your artist story.

target.text: Admin message: Please add your next radio date.

steps.caption: 2. Check your artist identity, roles and experience. Previous answers stay filled in.
3. Add a scene highlight requested by the reviewer.
4. Social profiles and follower counts are optional; follower counts are unverified.
5. Add context and resubmit. The review team receives the updated version.

actions.value: My next radio show is Friday at 8pm, featuring emerging local producers.
